title: DecryptRip instance
description: Per-template schema for decrypt-reveal. Core TemplateConfig fields (theme/global) are $ref-d from the global animations.schema.json. This template does NOT own content — it encrypts arbitrary `children` passed by the caller, so `elements[]` is unconstrained (any id) and typically empty. extras.* are extended here.

elements.description: Currently unused by decrypt-reveal itself — content is passed as `children` to <DecryptRip>. Kept in the schema for DeepConfig pipeline compatibility.

radius.description: Decrypt radius around the cursor in CSS pixels. The circle reveals real content wherever it passes

softness.description: Feather of the decrypt edge as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1)

cell.description: Glyph cell height in CSS pixels. Smaller cells = finer, denser cipher (and slower rendering)

aspect.description: Width of a glyph cell relative to its height (0.35 to 1.25)

charset.description: Characters the cipher is written in. Order does not matter, shapes are matched automatically. Max 255 glyphs

colored.description: How much glyphs keep the color of the UI beneath them, 0 is monochrome (0 to 1)

color.description: Cipher color as any CSS color. Used for monochrome glyphs and the decrypt edge tint

brightness.description: Brightness of the cipher glyphs (0.2 to 3)

legibility.description: Minimum contrast the cipher keeps against the background, so subtle UI stays readable while encrypted (0 to 1)

contrast.description: Contrast of the glyph shape matching. Higher picks bolder characters (0.3 to 3)

exposure.description: Exposure applied to the UI before it is matched to glyphs (0.2 to 3)

scramble.description: Fraction of idle cipher cells that keep mutating (0 to 1)

edgeWidth.description: Width of the decrypting flicker band as a fraction of the radius (0 to 1)

edgeFlicker.description: How violently characters flicker while they decrypt (0 to 1)

edgeGlow.description: Brightness surge of glyphs on the decrypt wavefront (0 to 3)

edgeTint.description: How strongly the wavefront tints toward the cipher color (0 to 1)

aberration.description: Chromatic aberration of the revealed UI at the decrypt edge in CSS pixels

passthrough.description: How much of the real UI shows through the cipher (0 to 1). 0 keeps the page fully encrypted

threshold.description: Contrast against the background above which a cell counts as UI and earns a glyph

background.description: Color of the backdrop behind the content, as any CSS color. Used to tell UI pixels apart from empty space. Match this to the scene's backdrop color

smoothing.description: Seconds the decrypt circle takes to catch up with the path (exponential damping). 0 tracks the lensPath exactly; higher feels more damped

lensPath.description: Decrypt circle path: waypoints {x, y, at} the circle follows over the composition. x/y are normalized screen positions (y is CSS-style: 0 = top, 1 = bottom; x outside 0-1 moves the circle off-frame for enter/exit). at is composition progress (0-1). The circle moves between waypoints with smoothstep timing, damped by `smoothing` like a cursor. Default: a left-to-right sweep across the composition. A static circle = two identical waypoints. Empty/missing falls back to the default sweep

x.description: Normalized horizontal circle center (0-1 across the frame; outside the frame for enter/exit)

y.description: Normalized vertical circle center, CSS y-down (0 = top, 1 = bottom)

at.description: Composition progress (0-1) at which the circle reaches this waypoint

activePath.description: Activation envelope: waypoints {at, v} of the decrypt circle's activation over the composition. v = 0 fully encrypted, 1 decrypt circle on; at is composition progress (0-1). Smoothstepped between waypoints and damped by `smoothing`. Default: on for the whole composition. 'Nothing until a reveal at 60%' = [{at: 0, v: 0}, {at: 0.6, v: 0}, {at: 0.62, v: 1}] (hold v at 0 until the trigger, then step up — the step is eased)

at.description: Composition progress (0-1) at which the envelope reaches this value

v.description: Activation value at this waypoint (0 = fully encrypted, 1 = decrypt circle on)
